title: EXP-07 Training Readiness and Optimization Risk Register

risks.mitigation: Enforced by GOV-RULE-062: Baseline training configuration is strictly frozen; sweeps and explorations are prohibited in the first training phase.

risks.risk_title: Overclaiming single-seed performance as robust baseline
risks.mitigation: Enforced by GOV-RULE-063: RUN-001 (seed 42) is designated a preliminary baseline; reporting robust metrics requires the full 3-seed replicate set (42, 101, 2024).

risks.risk_title: Untrained dry-run metrics conflated with trained model results
risks.mitigation: Enforced by GOV-RULE-064: C6 CPU dry-run metrics are classified as pipeline sanity checks and must never be cited as model performance.

risks.risk_title: Tile-level variance confused with independent-scene variance
risks.mitigation: Permanent disclosure that 72 TRAIN tiles originate from 12 independent Sentinel-1 parent scenes. Statistical reporting will include parent-stratified performance.

risks.risk_title: Gradient explosion on rare class HM (loss weight 12.16)
risks.mitigation: Mandatory gradient clipping with max_norm=1.0, norm_type=2.0 prior to optimizer step.

risks.risk_title: Silent retry with changed settings upon failure
risks.mitigation: Training failure policy mandates halting, capturing diagnostics to run_state.failed.json, and preserving artifacts without automatic retry.

risks.risk_title: Accidental HOLDOUT evaluation during routine training
risks.mitigation: Holdout access firewall blocks training loops and model selection from accessing HOLDOUT samples.

risks.risk_title: Checkpoint identity ambiguity or accidental overwrite
risks.mitigation: Each run outputs to an isolated directory (e.g. experiments/EXP-07/runs/run001_seed42) with embedded run ID, seed, and manifest SHA.

risks.risk_title: Early stopping based on noisy DEV validation in early epochs
risks.mitigation: Early stopping is inactive during warmup and early training (min_epochs=15, patience=10).

risks.risk_title: Conflating OPS-01 phenomenon segmentation with oil spill attribution
risks.mitigation: Explicit scope boundary: EXP-07 performs multiclass semantic segmentation of ocean phenomena; mineral oil spill (OS) is excluded from OPS-01 training.
